name: Violin (½ size)
description: A sweet, warm-sounding half-size violin that's ideal for young beginners. Small enough to hold comfortably and light enough to build good posture from day one.

details: ½ size — easy for younger players
Tuned and set up before lending

name: Keyboard (61-key)
description: A lightweight 61-key keyboard with a range of built-in sounds, a headphone jack, and simple controls. Perfect first instrument for exploring piano and composition.

name: Acoustic Guitar
description: A full-size steel-string dreadnought with a rich, projecting tone. Great for campfire songs, strumming, and learning chords.
notes: Some dings on the body and a small scratch on the top — cosmetic only. Fresh strings fitted and the action checked, so it plays comfortably.
details: Includes gig bag and clip-on tuner

name: Student Flute
description: A reliable student flute with a clear, bright tone. Closed-hole keys make it forgiving for first-timers learning hand position and embouchure.
notes: Pads recently checked and adjusted; a few minor scratches on the body. Includes case and cleaning kit.
